record.title: Long-Range Order for the Quantum Heisenberg Model
record.statement: (A) Prove long-range order for the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet in dimension $D>2$ at temperature $T>0$. record.title: Conjecture 3.13 — Blum, Cucker, Shub and Smale
record.statement:
Given an absolute constant $c$ and polynomials $P_1,\ldots,P_m$ with a
total of $N$ coefficients and no common complex zeros, there is no program
to find, in at most $N^c$ step, the coefficients of polynomials
$A_i$ satisfying B\'ezout's relation
$$
A_1P_1+\cdots+A_mP_m=1.
$$

r>0,\; |t|>\theta\}.
